text:
Madeline (growth): Quick huddle — post-launch checklist for tomorrow's webinar landing and the benchmark narrative distribution. Main SEO asks: canonical decisions, redirects for old blog posts, JSON-LD for webinar schema, internal link anchors from product pages, and inbound lead routing UTM sanity. Who's on what?

Theo (content): I'm in. Do we have final keywords? Need to update H1 + intro for benchmark narrative.

Raj (seo): I ran a quick keyword gap: "LLM inference latency benchmarking", "cost-optimized LLM serving", "inference platform SLA". Prioritize the first two. Also need a redirect map for 3 legacy blog URLs that overlap with the new benchmark post.

Sam (web): I can do redirects and canonical headers. Paste the list in the sheet and I’ll PR the nginx rules. Need exact paths + desired canonical targets.

Marta (pm): Messaging: CTA should be "See benchmark results" (primary) + "Get a demo" (secondary). Landing must preserve utm_source=webinar and route leads to /integrations/redwood-console for demos.

seo-bot: crawl-report: 3 pages flagged: /old-bench, /bench-draft, /webinar-landing-v1 — duplicate content. See: https://go.sheets/redirects

Kelly (analytics): Confirming we need click_id preserved through redirect chain. Sam make sure 302 vs 301 decision tied to tracking — prefer 302 for temp but dataset needs 301 for SEO.

Sam (web): Agreed. 301 for old posts we want canonicalized to benchmark page. 302 for A/B test landing.

Theo (content): Draft intro tweak: "Redwood Inference: a transparent benchmark for latency and cost across open LLMs." I'll push a 250-word hero and add internal links to /docs/performance and /blog/kv-cache.

Raj (seo): JSON-LD snippet for webinar event. Putting sample below — pls review and ensure fields match CMS values.

Raj (seo): ```
<script type="application/ld+json">
{
  "@context": "https://schema.org",
  "@type": "Event",
  "name": "Redwood Inference: Benchmarking LLM Inference",
  "startDate": "2026-05-12T10:00:00Z",
  "endDate": "2026-05-12T11:00:00Z",
  "eventAttendanceMode": "https://schema.org/OnlineEventAttendanceMode",
  "eventStatus": "https://schema.org/EventScheduled",
  "location": {
    "@type": "VirtualLocation",
    "url": "https://redwood.ai/webinar/benchmark"
  },
  "organizer": {
    "@type": "Organization",
    "name": "Redwood Inference",
    "url": "https://redwood.ai"
  },
  "description": "Live walkthrough of latency and cost benchmarks across open models, with Q&A.",
  "image": "https://redwood.ai/assets/webinar-thumb.png"
}
</script>
```

Marta (pm): Need alt text for image and final event URL for registration — don't hardcode until Reg form is live.

Sam (web): Also ensure hreflang and canonical tags on the webinar page — add rel=canonical to point to /webinar/benchmark.

Raj (seo): Internal link plan: from /docs/performance, /blog/kv-cache, /release-notes/quant, and product pages. Use anchor text "latency benchmarks" on docs and "cost per token" on product.

Madeline (growth): Owners & deadlines:
- Redirect map -> Sam (web) by EOD today
- JSON-LD & meta -> Raj + Theo by midday tomorrow
- Content hero + links -> Theo by EOD today
- Analytics param test -> Kelly by tomorrow morning
- Final sanity check -> Madeline before publish

Everyone OK? :thumbsup:

Theo (content): Ok. Will add the internal link snippets in the sheet: https://go.sheets/benchmark-ops

Sam (web): I'll open a PR and ping eng-oncall for deploy window.

Kelly (analytics): I'll run test clicks from staging and share results.

Marta (pm): Also check that webinar landing is included in the post-launch email flow — cc: marketing-campaigns.

Madeline (growth): Perfect. If no blockers we'll roll at 09:00 PT. Ping me if anything needs re-prioritizing.

seo-bot: reminder: scheduled sitemap ping at 08:05 PT on publish day.
